\begin{algorithm}[t]
\caption{FedContra training loop.}
\label{alg:fedcontra}
\begin{algorithmic}
\STATE Initialize global model $\theta_0$
\FOR{each round $t = 1, \dots, T$}
\STATE Sample clients and broadcast $\theta_t$
\STATE Update local models with task loss
\STATE Aggregate with contrastive regularizer
\ENDFOR
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
